_comment: Edit this file to change digest behaviour. Commit the change and the next run picks it up.
_days_back_comment: How many days back to look for new content. 2 gives a buffer so weekend gaps don't miss Monday's news.
_max_items_comment: Cap on articles fetched per source per run. Prevents a single prolific org from flooding the digest.
_min_items_comment: If fewer than this many articles are found across all sources, skip the email for that run.
_model_comment: Claude model used for digest generation.
